Title: Understand project layout
Why_First: You cannot build what you do not understand
What_To_Do: Read routes.go + main.go + models.go + Tasks.md top to bottom. Draw a box diagram on paper: Browser → HTTP → Handler → DB/Redis

Title: Verify the project compiles and runs today
Why_First: Catch broken imports before adding new code
What_To_Do: Run: go build ./... and fix any compile errors. Then go run cmd/server/main.go and confirm server starts

Title: Implement standard JSON response envelope helper
Why_First: Every handler you write from now on will use this. Do it once now.
What_To_Do: envelope.go already has structs. Add a WriteSuccess and WriteError helper func that calls json.NewEncoder(w).Encode and sets Content-Type header

Title: Implement Request-ID middleware
Why_First: Needed by envelope Meta.RequestID in every response
What_To_Do: Middleware reads X-Request-ID header or generates id with atomic counter suffix. Stores in context. Passes to next handler.

Title: Implement logging middleware
Why_First: You need to see every request in logs while building
What_To_Do: Logs method + path + status + duration using zap. Wraps next handler.

Title: Implement input validation helper
Why_First: All auth handlers need this immediately
What_To_Do: BindAndValidate decodes JSON body and runs go-playground/validator. Returns 400 on error using WriteError.

Title: Wire new middleware into router
Why_First: Middleware is useless until registered
What_To_Do: router.Use(middleware.RequestID) and router.Use(middleware.Logger) wired at top of StartHTTPServer.

Title: Run + verify DB migrations 000012-000016
Why_First: Auth and settings handlers need these tables to exist
What_To_Do: Run migrate up for 000012 through 000016. Confirm tables: user_settings watchlists backtest_jobs notification_channels audit_events

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/signup
Why_First: Login cannot exist without signup. This is the entry point for all users
What_To_Do: bcrypt cost 12 + validation + token pair returned on 201.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/login
Why_First: Users need a token to call any protected endpoint
What_To_Do: bcrypt compare + IsActive check + token pair + generic error message prevents email enumeration.

Title: Create JWT helper package
Why_First: Signup and login both need token generation and parsing in one place
What_To_Do: GenerateAccessToken GenerateRefreshToken and ParseToken using golang-jwt/jwt. Reads JWT_SECRET from env.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/refresh
Why_First: Without this users get logged out every 15 minutes
What_To_Do: Validates refresh token type + issues new rotated access+refresh pair.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/auth/logout
Why_First: Complete the auth lifecycle
What_To_Do: Writes refresh token to Redis blocklist with remaining TTL. Returns 204.

Title: Implement JWT auth middleware
Why_First: Without this every endpoint is public. This is the security gate
What_To_Do: Parses Bearer JWT. Rejects 401 if invalid or blocklisted. Stores userID in context.

Title: Register all auth routes + protect routes
Why_First: Wire everything built so far into the router
What_To_Do: /api/v1/auth/* routes registered. Protected subrouter with authMiddleware applied.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/me
Why_First: First protected endpoint. Proves auth middleware works end to end
What_To_Do: Reads userID from context. Queries User by PK. Returns meResponse (no PasswordHash).

Title: Manual test auth flow end to end
Why_First: Catch bugs before building on top of broken auth
What_To_Do: Use curl or Postman: signup → login → /me → refresh → logout → confirm /me returns 401

Title: Implement rate limiting middleware
Why_First: Auth endpoints are brute-force targets. Add this now before going further
What_To_Do: Per-IP token bucket using golang.org/x/time/rate. Cleanup goroutine removes stale entries.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/settings
Why_First: Frontend Settings.tsx is already built and waiting for this
What_To_Do: Query user_settings table by userID. Return settings JSON. Decrypt secret fields before returning.

Title: Implement PUT /api/v1/settings
Why_First: Pair with GET so settings are actually usable
What_To_Do: Decode body. Encrypt secret fields. Upsert into user_settings. Return updated settings.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/health
Why_First: You need this to know if the server is alive during all future testing
What_To_Do: Implemented in api_v1.go. Pings DB and Redis. Returns uptime + mode + dependency status.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/brokers/zerodha/status
Why_First: Broker connection is needed before any live order or position endpoint works
What_To_Do: Implemented in api_v1.go. Calls GetUserProfile if client is set. Returns connected/disconnected state.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/brokers/zerodha/connect + callback + disconnect
Why_First: Complete the OAuth flow so Zerodha token can be stored
What_To_Do: connect: store encrypted API key+secret. callback: exchange request_token for access_token. disconnect: set IsActive=false.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/instruments/search
Why_First: Needed by watchlist and order placement. Simple DB query
What_To_Do: Accept q query param. SELECT from instruments WHERE tradingsymbol ILIKE '%q%' LIMIT 20. Return array.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/candles
Why_First: Frontend chart needs historical candles on load before WebSocket kicks in
What_To_Do: Accept token interval from and to query params. Query ohlcv_candles table. Return array of OHLCV objects.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/market/overview
Why_First: MarketData.tsx and MarketOverview.tsx are waiting for this
What_To_Do: Implemented in api_v1.go. Uses heatmap snapshot. Returns indices + gainers + losers + breadth.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/watchlists/default
Why_First: Frontend watchlist panel needs this to show saved symbols
What_To_Do: Query watchlists + watchlist_items joined for current user. Return list of symbols with last price from Redis cache.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/watchlists/default/items
Why_First: Pair with GET so user can add symbols
What_To_Do: Validate instrument token exists. Insert into watchlist_items. Return updated watchlist.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/orders
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx needs order list
What_To_Do: Query orders table WHERE user_id = currentUser. Support status filter. Return paginated list.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/orders
Why_First: Core trading action. Paper trading mode first
What_To_Do: Validate body. Check simulate flag. If paper: insert PENDING order. If live: call Zerodha PlaceOrder. Idempotency key required.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/positions
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx is the main dashboard panel
What_To_Do: Query positions table WHERE user_id = currentUser AND quantity != 0. Return list with unrealized PnL.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/trades
Why_First: Show trade history in UI
What_To_Do: Query trades table WHERE user_id = currentUser. Support date range filter. Return paginated list.

Title: Implement DELETE /api/v1/orders/{id} and PUT /api/v1/orders/{id}
Why_First: Users need to cancel or modify open orders
What_To_Do: DELETE: set status CANCELLED. If live call Zerodha CancelOrder. PUT: modify price/qty for OPEN orders.

Title: Implement WebSocket hub with topic subscriptions
Why_First: All WS panels need a unified hub. Build the core first
What_To_Do: Hub struct with map of topic to set of connections. Register Unregister Broadcast methods. SUBSCRIBE/UNSUBSCRIBE protocol.

Title: Wire hub into router and replace old WS handlers
Why_First: Old /ws /ws/candles /ws/indicators are separate. Unify under /ws/v1/dashboard
What_To_Do: Add /ws/v1/dashboard route pointing to hub.ServeWS. Keep old routes temporarily for backward compat.

Title: Implement WS topic: orders and positions
Why_First: PositionsPanel.tsx subscribes to these
What_To_Do: When order or position is saved to DB call hub.Broadcast(topicOrders) and hub.Broadcast(topicPositions).

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/strategies
Why_First: StrategyPanel.tsx needs list of available strategies
What_To_Do: Return list of strategy names. Include enabled status from user_strategies table.

Title: Implement PUT /api/v1/user/strategies/{name}
Why_First: User needs to enable/disable strategies
What_To_Do: Upsert into user_strategies with IsEnabled and Parameters JSON. Return updated config.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/strategies/{name}/start and /stop
Why_First: StrategyPanel start/stop buttons
What_To_Do: start: set IsEnabled=true. stop: set IsEnabled=false and signal goroutine to stop.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/signals
Why_First: StrategyPanel signal feed
What_To_Do: Query signals table or Redis cache. Return latest N signals per strategy.

Title: Implement WS topic: signals
Why_First: StrategyPanel.tsx live signal stream
What_To_Do: Call hub.Broadcast(topicSignals) whenever a new signal is generated by strategy runner.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/backtests
Why_First: Submit async backtest job
What_To_Do: Decode strategy + date range + params. Insert into backtest_jobs with status PENDING. Launch goroutine. Return job ID.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/backtests/{id}
Why_First: Poll backtest result
What_To_Do: Query backtest_jobs by id and user_id. Return status + result JSON when complete.

Title: Implement WS topic: backtests/{id}
Why_First: Stream backtest progress to UI
What_To_Do: In backtest goroutine call hub.Broadcast(topicBacktest+id progressPayload) periodically.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/models
Why_First: MLModelsPanel.tsx model list
What_To_Do: Scan models/ directory for .onnx files. Return list with filename version active status.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/models/{id}/activate
Why_First: Switch active model
What_To_Do: Validate model file exists. Store active model name in Redis. Return updated model list.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/models/jobs
Why_First: List training jobs
What_To_Do: Query model_jobs table or Redis. Return list of job status.

Title: Implement WS topic: models
Why_First: Stream training progress
What_To_Do: In retrain goroutine call hub.Broadcast(topicModels progressPayload) at each step.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/news
Why_First: SentimentPanel.tsx news feed
What_To_Do: Uncomment and fix news_pipeline.go. Query news_articles ordered by published_at DESC. Support limit and page.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/sentiment/summary
Why_First: Sentiment score summary for dashboard
What_To_Do: Aggregate avg sentiment_score from news_articles in last 24h grouped by label. Return counts and avg score.

Title: Implement WS topic: sentiment
Why_First: Stream new articles live
What_To_Do: After inserting article call hub.Broadcast(topicSentiment articlePayload).

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/notifications/test
Why_First: Test Telegram or WhatsApp notification
What_To_Do: Read channel config from user_settings. Call Telegram Bot API or WhatsApp API. Return success or error.

Title: Implement WS topic: alerts
Why_First: Stream risk and error alerts
What_To_Do: Call hub.Broadcast(topicAlerts) from order monitor and strategy runner when risk limits hit.

Title: Implement audit event logging
Why_First: Track all sensitive actions for security
What_To_Do: Write LogAuditEvent func that inserts into audit_events table. Call from login logout broker-connect order-place handlers.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/runtime/config
Why_First: Dashboard header needs mode and server time
What_To_Do: Return appCfg.Market.Simulate mode + server time + JWT expiry + configured intervals. No secrets.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/runtime/metrics
Why_First: System health panel
What_To_Do: Return connected WS clients count + DB ping latency + Redis ping latency + memory stats.

Title: Implement PATCH /api/v1/me
Why_First: Settings page profile update
What_To_Do: Validates userName (min 1 max 100). Updates user_name column. Returns updated meResponse.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/indicators (REST)
Why_First: Chart needs indicator seed data on load
What_To_Do: Accept token interval indicator period params. Query IndicatorSMA/EMA/RSI/MACD table. Return timestamped values.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/quotes
Why_First: Batch quote endpoint for watchlist prices
What_To_Do: Implemented in api_v1.go. Fetches from Zerodha or falls back to heatmap snapshot.

Title: Implement POST /api/v1/gtt and GET /api/v1/gtt
Why_First: GTT orders for PositionsPanel
What_To_Do: POST: validate trigger price and target. Insert order with ValidUntil set. GET: query GTT orders for current user.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/market/heatmap (REST)
Why_First: Initial heatmap render before WS connects
What_To_Do: Call data.GetMarketHeatmap().Snapshot(). Return as JSON.

Title: Implement GET /api/v1/instruments/{token}
Why_First: Instrument detail by token
What_To_Do: Query instruments WHERE instrument_token = token. Return full instrument struct.

Title: Remove old /api/data/users and /api/cache/test debug routes
Why_First: Old debug routes expose raw DB data publicly
What_To_Do: Remove /api/data/users and /api/cache/test. Move /api/instrument to /api/v1/instruments/search. All behind auth.

Title: Extract instrument seeding into cmd/server/seed.go
Why_First: main.go is 300+ lines. Hard to read and maintain
What_To_Do: Move instrument seeding loop into seedInstruments(ctx dbClient instruments) func in new file.

Title: Write integration test for auth flow
Why_First: Catch regressions as you add more features
What_To_Do: Use httptest.NewRecorder. Test signup → login → /me → refresh → logout sequence.

Title: Tighten CORS: replace wildcard with allowed origins from config
Why_First: Production readiness. Wildcard CORS is a security risk
What_To_Do: ALLOWED_ORIGINS env var read. corsAllowedOrigins() returns allowlist. Wildcard removed.

Title: Add idempotency key check on POST /api/v1/orders
Why_First: Prevent duplicate orders on network retry
What_To_Do: Read Idempotency-Key header. Check Redis for existing response. Cache result for 24h.

Title: Review and fill all empty doc.go packages
Why_First: Empty packages need real code or removal
What_To_Do: For each package: implement or delete and remove the import. Do not leave empty placeholder packages in production.

Title: End-to-end smoke test of entire system
Why_First: Verify everything works together before calling v1 done
What_To_Do: Start server. Test: login → dashboard → watchlist → paper order → position → backtest → sentiment → notification.

Title: Fix simulation mode nil-pointer crash
Why_First: Server crashed on startup in simulate mode
What_To_Do: Zerodha validation and instrument subscription guarded behind !simulate. simInstruments variable shadowing fixed.

Title: Add WebSocket read deadlines and pong handlers
Why_First: Stale connections hung indefinitely with no timeout
What_To_Do: SetReadLimit + SetReadDeadline + SetPongHandler added to /ws /ws/candles /ws/indicators /ws/heatmap.

Title: Add WebSocket ping and write deadlines to all writePumps
Why_First: No heartbeat meant dead clients were never detected
What_To_Do: Ping ticker (45s) and write deadline (10s) added to all three writePump implementations.

Title: Fix heatmap broadcast blocking and no context cancellation
Why_First: Blocking write with no deadline + no shutdown path
What_To_Do: Context cancellation + write deadlines + ping ticker + background read drain goroutine added.

Title: Fix Redis pubsub reconnect connection leak
Why_First: Old pubsub was not closed before reassigning on reconnect
What_To_Do: pubsub.Close() + nil before reassign. time.Sleep replaced with context-aware select.

Title: Replace Fatal calls in worker goroutines
Why_First: Fatal from background goroutine kills entire process
What_To_Do: All Fatal in subscribeAndProcessRedis + startDBFlusher + candle subscribe replaced with Error+return.

Title: Fix double-close panic on monitorStopCh
Why_First: ctx.Done branch and defer both closed the same channel
What_To_Do: Safe-close pattern applied. Redundant close in ctx.Done branch removed.

Title: Fix tick depth array access safety
Why_First: Direct [5]DepthItem array — confirmed always 5 elements. Previous guard silently dropped valid ticks.
What_To_Do: Direct array assignment used. Unnecessary skip-on-partial-depth guard removed.

Title: Fix flaky TestRequestID_UniquePerRequest test
Why_First: UnixNano collisions under rapid sequential requests
What_To_Do: Atomic counter suffix added to generated request IDs. All tests now pass.
